name: Zigbee Coordinator
summary: A Zigbee coordinator that Zigbee2MQTT reaches over Wi-Fi
description:
Runs the Zigbee network on the chip's own 802.15.4 radio and serves it to Zigbee2MQTT over Wi-Fi, so the coordinator can sit where the devices are rather than in a USB port of the server. Set Zigbee2MQTT's adapter to zboss and its port to tcp://<device>:6638, or mdns://espos-zigbee. One Zigbee2MQTT at a time per coordinator.

It decodes nothing itself: devices, their values and their Signal K paths are Zigbee2MQTT's. Only the ESP32-C5 and ESP32-C6 have the radio.

boards.notes: Joins a 2.4 or 5 GHz Wi-Fi network; Zigbee itself is always on 2.4 GHz.
Needs 8 MB of flash; the 4 MB kits are too small.
